scope: Current composition-document guide, status, roadmap, architecture, testing, export/package rules, portable engine and example documentation; generated atlas views and local Markdown links/anchors. Historical evidence is not rewritten.
reviewedBoundaries: Recipe is an ordinary registered JSON author document; top-level format selects semantics, deletion returns to ordinary JSON without filename inference.
Dependencies come from all current template/override declarations and merge authored edges without metadata writes; invalid source remains normally saveable and fully backupable.
Selective package reader/import checks declared dependency completeness, categories and pinned requirements even if a target happens to contain the same UUID.
Registered CLI origin describes read-only source/world provenance; it checks declared availability and image kind, not actual image bytes or runtime feasibility.
1464 app tests and 336 syntax files describe the completed full run; the subsequently added browser smoke has a separate syntax check and actual Chrome five-step evidence.
Dedicated recipe preview/override editing, reverse write-back, nested/cross-file composition, installers and Android devices remain outside acceptance.
rerun: Use VIENTO_COMPOSITION_SMOKE_OUTPUT with a new report directory; the script refuses to overwrite an existing browser.json.
